name: freellmapi
description: 7.4 billion tokens per month. 34 free LLM providers. 635 free model endpoints. All behind one /v1 endpoint, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Smart routing, automatic failover, encrypted keys. Personal experimentation only.
one_liner: One login that quietly combines dozens of free AI chatbot providers' free usage limits into a single API, so you get far more free AI usage before hitting any paywall.
buyer: A hobbyist developer or indie hacker prototyping an AI app who wants to avoid paying for API credits early on.
business_use_cases: An indie developer prototypes an AI feature entirely on aggregated free tiers before committing to a paid API budget.
A student building a class project gets a generous, reliable amount of free AI usage without juggling accounts.

money_ideas.idea: There isn't a legitimate business here — the project itself says 'personal experimentation only,' and it runs on providers' free tiers, which reselling access would violate.

steal_this: Use it to prototype your own AI side-project for free before you have paying users — not as something to build a company on.
